gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the clip-on AeroClip 2's battery drops from 8 h to 5 h per charge when you're on calls (32 h to 20 h with the case). The OpenComm2's 16 h talk time is double its 8 h music figure, so the earbud battery figures those pages quote are music-mode numbers that overstate battery life on calls.
standout_why: I opened four of the pages ChatGPT got. Digital Trends' OpenFit 2 vs AeroFit 2 piece (cited) gives one 'up to' figure per model (11 h / 48 h and 10 h / 42 h) and doesn't separate talk time from music time. realbuyerexperiences (cited) gives only per-charge and with-case figures and no talk time for any model. openearclub's work page (cited in one chat) comes closest: it lists 16 h talk vs 8 h listening for the OpenComm2 UC and says every earbud page 'leads with listening battery'. But it only covers the first AeroClip (8 h) and shows no call-mode figure for any earbud. None of them has the AeroClip 2's maker-stated call-mode figure. Three pages I couldn't read: Soundcore's uat blog (cited, returned 401), and RTINGS' best-of list and OpenComm2 review (neither returned review content). I can't rule those out.
decides: This backs the boom-mic headset as the pick for long workdays of calls. On calls the OpenComm2 (2025) is rated at 16 h, more than three times the AeroClip 2's 5 h call mode. The AeroClip 2 is still the pick for the best call quality without a boom: Expert Reviews' Andy White calls its calls 'head and shoulders above their rivals', and Soundcore holds a Guinness 'Highest G-MOS' certification for it. The page has to show its 5 h call figure, not the 8 h music figure or the 10–11 h claim in Soundcore's own blog. Our current table already has '5 h calls / 8 h music'; the rebuild should footnote that every earbud row without a call figure is listing music time.

findings.label: Battery per charge, call mode vs music mode
findings.value: 5 h on calls / 8 h music per charge; 20 h / 32 h with the case
findings.note: From the post's comparison table: 'Call Mode：5h Per Charge /20h with case' and 'Music Mode：8h Per Charge / 32h with case'. Call time is 5/8 = 62.5% of music time. The same post also says 'around 10 to 11 hours per charge' and '42 to 45 hours' in its battery section, which contradicts its own table and Expert Reviews' rated 8 h / 32 h, so don't use those figures.
